purpose: Cell (b) of the three Earnings-22 model-usage alignment cells: ONE factor, a duration-proportional generation cap, on 1,500 rows of this study's own Earnings-22 DEV subset10, paired row for row against the SEALED comparator on identical audio bytes. The request is byte-identical to the sealed arm A's in every field but one -- the integer in max_tokens, which is resolved per sample from that sample's own media duration instead of being the cell-wide 1024. Preregistration: docs/readiness/2026-09-06-e22-dev-usage-cells-v1-preregistration.md section 2. NOT AUTHORIZED by this fragment: the cell needs its own owner GO, its own exposure row registered before the first contact, and its own contracts.ExecutionPlan.

basis.clip_boundary_excluded: docs/readiness/2026-09-06-e22-clip-boundary-audit-v1.md and docs/readiness/2026-09-06-e22-esb-array-durations-v1.md -- the published segmentation overlaps and the ESB release's own arrays carry that overlap
basis.decode_discipline_bounded: docs/readiness/2026-09-06-e22-overgeneration-analysis-v1.md -- decode discipline is bounded at 0.73 dev WER points and the achievable share at a non-worsening agentic rate is 0.23

comparator.why_sealed_and_never_a_rerun: Greedy decoding is not bitwise reproducible across batch compositions on this runtime, so the contrast is against sealed outputs. No new arm A is flown.

subset_uncapped_numbers.source: section 5.4 of the over-generation verdict, measured model-free before this cell existed

E22-ESB-DEV1500-UTTERANCES.selection: 150 per source call at seed 20260906 through core.roster.freeze_roster, by the model-free row SAEA-SN-MF-E22-DEV1500-ROSTER-V1
E22-ESB-DEV1500-UTTERANCES.estimand: the paired within-utterance effect of the generation cap on corpus WER and on the agentic error rate, on a population this study is allowed to optimize on

cells.serving_geometry: -c 40960 -np 8, 5120 tokens per slot -- the sealed comparator's, unchanged
cells.factor: the generation cap: n_predict resolved per sample from the sample's own duration

shared_protocol.audio_path: raw audio, bf16 mmproj resident on the GPU, no feature cache directory
shared_protocol.max_tokens: PER SAMPLE: min(1024, max(1, ceil(1.5 * media_seconds * 4.999220954734555 * 1.2991996296395218))) -- 10 tokens for a 1 s clip, 49 for 5 s, 98 for 10 s, 321 for this subset's 32.88 s longest. Declared as a rule object in the model fragment's decoding_params and resolved by core.flight.FlightRuntime through the 'duration-proportional-v1' entry of core.base.MAX_TOKENS_POLICIES.
shared_protocol.obs: none -- an ESB utterance IS the request; there is no windowing here
shared_protocol.harness: core.flight.FlightRuntime with the shared rails zero-supply direct arm and the OpenJiuwen executor, entered through scripts/flights/run_e22_esb_cell.py -- the same harness and entry point the sealed comparator used
shared_protocol.prompt_shape: the base TaskAdapter.assemble_prompt default: one system message carrying the instruction, one user message carrying the audio. IDENTICAL to the comparator.
shared_protocol.stop_strings: NONE, and none may be added; section 2.4 of the preregistration refuses one by name
shared_protocol.the_only_difference: the integer in max_tokens. Same roster, same media bytes, same instruction, same reference layer, same scorers, same build, same decoder, same geometry, same harness, same entry point, same prompt shape.

execution_plan_basis.planned_model_calls: 1,500 rows x 1 contact + 8 canaries = 1,508; the registered exposure ceiling is 1,600.
execution_plan_basis.planned_speech_audio_seconds: 9,948.983 s for one pass, rounded up to 10,000; the registered ceiling is 10,500.
execution_plan_basis.planned_gpu_hours: 0.20 planned, 0.35 registered. The sealed comparator used 0.4515 GPU-h for 6,038 contacts on the same runtime and geometry; 1,500 is 24.8 % of that, about 0.112 h, and the cap can only shorten generation. Expected dispatch is about 400 s at eight slots (the comparator ran 3.744 contacts/s).
execution_plan_basis.cumulative_metering: contracts.ExecutionPlan carries no ceiling field; the registered ceilings are the exposure row's own calls / speech-audio-seconds / gpu-hours cells, and the plan budget is metered CUMULATIVELY across every attempt of this run id, so a recovery plan must cover prior durable spend as well as its own worst case.

decision.rule: ADMITTED as a model-usage local optimization iff BOTH hold: (1) corpus WER improves and the CI90 upper bound on the delta is below 0; and (2) the agentic error rate does not worsen -- the CI90 upper bound on its delta is below +0.05 points.
decision.non_inferiority_margin_provenance: +0.05 points, inherited verbatim from section 1.6 of docs/readiness/2026-09-06-e22-dev-boundary-exact-v1-preregistration.md and fixed before any number exists.
decision.why_clause_two_reads_a_ci: On the full 6,038 rows the alpha-1.5 cap's predicted agentic delta is -0.0009; on these 1,500 it is +0.0267, on 50 capped rows of which 15 are harmed. That is noise around zero at this sample size, and the margin was set to accommodate exactly this rather than chosen after seeing it.
decision.claim_surface: A dev number on a 1,500-row subset of this study's own dev split. This is NOT an alignment verdict, it is not compared to the published 9.79 or 12.3 as a difference, and the published figures appear as orientation only where they appear at all.
decision.test_read: NONE. This is not a scorer-side change -- the cap changes the request -- so applying it to the six calibration-exposed ESB test calls would require RE-FLYING them, a second read of a population the 2026-09-04 owner allowance permitted once. It may be proposed to the owner and never taken on this fragment's authority.
decision.not_authorized: No mechanism arm. No knob tuned on the test split. No fourth prompt. No few-shot. No post-processing of any hypothesis. No re-scoring of any sealed arm. No merge_compounds. No packet or feature-cache path. No stop string. No second read of the six calibration-exposed ESB test calls. No read of any confirmatory call. No paper-scale-confirmatory profile, no manuscript, no submission, no Stage-3 activity.

companion_run.why_separate: contracts.gate_exposure requires exactly one pre-registered exposure row per run id whose split identity hash equals the plan's, and the smoke's four rows have a different split identity hash and a much smaller budget, so it cannot share a run id with the flight.
